premise: One night Starfish sees shooting stars and thinks they are her cousins in the sky; Turtle tells her they are stars of the sky, and she is a star of the sea.
inspiration: The star-gazing tales of folk tradition (the child who wants to touch the stars), turned around: the little one is a star already.
lesson: You don't have to be far away to shine.

en-US.title: Starfish and the Shooting Stars
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s} [softly] It was night on the beach, and the moon shone on the water. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish couldn't sleep. {starfish:face happy} She was looking up. {canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s} [gasps] A star went whizzing across the sky! Then another! {starfish:face surprised} {starfish:live jump} Look! My cousins! They're starfish too! {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to starfish} Turtle came crawling up, slowly. {starfish:go to turtle} {turtle:face happy} [warmly] Those are stars of the sky, little one. {turtle:live stretch-neck} Far, far away. And you… you're a star of the sea. {starfish:sparkle} {starfish:live wave} Starfish waved all five arms at the sky. Goodnight, cousins! {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Seal looked up from the rocks. {seal:face happy} [whispers] Make a wish, said Seal. So they did, all three. {seal:glow 0.3} [long pause] {turtle:live peek hold} Turtle tucked her head in. {seal:face sleeping} Seal closed her eyes. [softly] And Starfish, the littlest star of all, {starfish:live sleep hold} fell asleep under the stars of the sky.

es-ES.title: Estrella y las estrellas fugaces
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s} [softly] Era de noche en la playa, y la luna brillaba sobre el agua. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Estrella no podía dormir. {starfish:face happy} Estaba mirando hacia arriba. {canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s} [gasps] ¡Una estrella cruzó el cielo, zas! ¡Y otra! {starfish:face surprised} {starfish:live jump} ¡Mirad! ¡Mis primas! ¡Son estrellas de mar, como yo! {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to starfish} Tortuga llegó arrastrándose, despacito. {starfish:go to turtle} {turtle:face happy} [warmly] Esas son estrellas del cielo, pequeña. {turtle:live stretch-neck} Están muy, muy lejos. Y tú… tú eres una estrella del mar. {starfish:sparkle} {starfish:live wave} Estrella saludó al cielo con sus cinco brazos. ¡Buenas noches, primas! {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca levantó la vista desde las rocas. {seal:face happy} [whispers] Pedid un deseo, dijo Foca. Y eso hicieron, las tres. {seal:glow 0.3} [long pause] {turtle:live peek hold} Tortuga escondió la cabeza. {seal:face sleeping} Foca cerró los ojos. [softly] Y Estrella, la estrellita más pequeña de todas, {starfish:live sleep hold} se durmió bajo las estrellas del cielo.

ja-JP.title: ヒトデさんと ながれぼし
ja-JP.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s}[softly]うみべの夜。お月さまが、水の上をてらしています。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}ヒトデさんは、ねむれません。{starfish:face happy}空を、見上げていました。{canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s}[gasps]ほしが、すーっと空をはしった！ほら、もうひとつ！{starfish:face surprised}{starfish:live jump}「見て！わたしのいとこたち！みんな、ほしのかたちだもん！」 {turtle:enter}{turtle:go to starfish}ウミガメさんが、ゆっくり、はってきました。{starfish:go to turtle}{turtle:face happy}[warmly]「あれは、空のおほしさまよ、おちびさん。{turtle:live stretch-neck}ずっと、ずーっと、とおく。そして、あなたは…海のおほしさま」 {starfish:sparkle}{starfish:live wave}ヒトデさんは、五本のうでを、空にふりふり。「おやすみ、いとこたち！」 {seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}アザラシさんも、岩の上から見上げました。{seal:face happy}[whispers]「おねがいごと、しよう」 とアザラシさん。三人は、そっとおねがいしました。{seal:glow 0.3}[pause]{turtle:live peek hold}ウミガメさんは、くびをひっこめました。{seal:face sleeping}アザラシさんは、目をとじました。[softly]そして、いちばん小さなおほしさま、ヒトデさんも、{starfish:live sleep hold}空のおほしさまの下で、すやすやねむりました。
